name: Buildkite hosted agents

modes.label: macOS M4 hosted agents, $0.02 per vCPU-minute
modes.note: macOS $0.02 per vCPU-minute (Pro/Enterprise only; no included Mac minutes on Pro, pay-as-you-go), metered to the second, no minimums, no rounding. Mac concurrency up to 48 vCPU on Pro (8 Medium or 4 Large). Max 4 h per job (longer on request). Apple Virtualization framework VMs.

modes.label: Hosted Linux agents (Small..Large)
modes.note: CI runner. Added 2026-09-28 (missing-providers audit). https://buildkite.com/pricing: Linux $0.004 per vCPU-minute (Small $0.008/min, Medium $0.016, Large $0.032); shapes from https://buildkite.com/docs/pipelines/hosted-agents/linux. Free plan: Small only (not enforced per size). Max 8 h per job. Per-second metering assumed same as macOS (stated for macOS).

modes.label: Hosted Linux agents XL..3XL (Enterprise)
modes.note: CI runner. Added 2026-09-28 (missing-providers audit). https://buildkite.com/docs/pipelines/hosted-agents/linux: XL/XXL/3XL require Enterprise. Price derived from $0.004/vCPU-min (https://buildkite.com/pricing); Enterprise pricing is custom.

modes.label: Windows hosted agents (private preview)
modes.note: Windows Server 2022, ephemeral VM per job; no custom images, no cache volumes, no SSH/VNC. Price not published.

plans.name: Free
plans.note: Up to 5 users; up to 10 concurrent jobs; Linux vCPU concurrency 20 vCPU (= 10 Small); hosted Linux usage is capped at 'Up to 2,000 mins/month, Small only' (no per-minute overage listed for Free, unlike Pro's 'Additional at per-minute rates'); no macOS; no cache volumes; 4 h job timeout.

plans.name: Pro
plans.note: $30 per active user/month (active = anyone who logs in, uses the API or triggers a build that month); up to 50 users; 4,000 Linux vCPU-minutes/month included ($16), then per-minute; macOS pay-as-you-go (no included Mac minutes). Concurrency: 256 Linux vCPU (128 Small / 64 Medium / 32 Large) and 48 macOS vCPU (8 Medium / 4 Large); a machine counts from boot. Encoded as 32 concurrent machines. Cache volumes included (no published price).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Custom pricing; 30 active-user minimum (per-user price not published); unlimited users; volume discounts on vCPU minutes; XL..3XL and ARM64 Linux shapes; custom concurrency.

caveats: CI agents only (jobs from Buildkite pipelines).
Included Linux minutes don't cover macOS.
Billed per vCPU-minute metered to the second, no minimums (pricing page).
Pro concurrency cap is per vCPU (256 Linux / 48 macOS); encoded as 32 concurrent machines, which is exact only for 8-vCPU Linux agents.
ARM64 Linux shapes are Enterprise-only; not encoded separately.
Linux XL..3XL hourly derived from the published $0.004/vCPU-minute rate.

Cache volumes (Pro/Enterprise only; not on Free) have no published price; best-effort, retained up to 14 days from last use; default quotas: container cache 50 GB, Git mirror 5 GB, max cache size 128 GB; min volume size 20 GB.
Linux ARM64 is billed as a separate platform with its own per-vCPU-minute rate (not published; Enterprise, on request).
Concurrency counts a machine from boot, so short jobs consume capacity beyond run time; jobs over the vCPU cap queue (no overage).

fleet.verification: All Access Trial onboarding; billing requirements for production were not established.
fleet.tiers: New All Access Trial: Linux 24 vCPU and M4 Mac 12 vCPU. Free thereafter: Linux 20, no Mac; Pro: Linux 256, M4 Mac 48. Trial/Enterprise adjustable on request.
fleet.notes: Hosted concurrency is a vCPU pool, not pricing-page self-hosted agent count. CPU field represents Linux trial pool; each booting/running agent consumes its shape vCPUs. Trial spending cap also applies.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

snapshot_auto.quote: Version commits follow a "last write" model—whenever a job terminates successfully (that is, exits with exit code `0`), volumes attached to that job have a new parent committed—the final flushed volume of the exiting agent instance.
snapshot_auto.note: Only cache volumes (paths declared under `cache:` in pipeline.yml, plus cluster-level container-cache and Git-mirror volumes), Linux + macOS, not Windows. Committed only on successful jobs; next job gets a fork of the last committed version. Best-effort: retained up to 14 days from last use, not guaranteed. Root/VM state and memory are always destroyed after each job. Pro/Enterprise only.

egress_allowlist.quote: For organizations building products where a zero-trust build environment and infrastructure is required, the recommendation is to use self-hosted agents to build these products.
egress_allowlist.note: Hosted network-security docs cover only egress IP ranges for allowlisting on the customer's side (Networking > Network Ranges, REST network-ranges API; ranges shared across customers; dedicated static IPs via support). Self-hosted is recommended to "Control network security rules directly." No provider-side egress filtering documented.

ingress_rules.quote: The terminal access feature is available to users who have/are any of the following:
ingress_rules.note: No exposed ports/URLs at all on hosted agents; the only inbound path is permission-gated terminal access (Buildkite UI, `bk job ssh`), macOS desktop access, and org-level remote-access on/off. No IP allowlists/security groups for inbound. Value false = no user-configurable ingress for services.

secret_proxy.quote: The following headers are controlled by the Buildkite proxy and cannot be overridden by the client:
secret_proxy.note: Model providers (Anthropic only): agents call $BUILDKITE_AGENT_ENDPOINT/ai/anthropic with the per-job token ($BUILDKITE_AGENT_ACCESS_TOKEN); Buildkite injects x-api-key (Buildkite-hosted token on Pro/Enterprise, or your own BYO Anthropic key), so the real key never enters the agent. Works for Claude Code. Other secrets (Buildkite secrets, cluster-scoped) are fetched into the job as values; no generic credential-injecting proxy; no DB/SSH/git coverage.

volume_attach.quote: Cache volumes (also known as volumes) are external volumes attached to Buildkite hosted agent instances, and are scoped to specific Buildkite clusters.
volume_attach.note: NVMe-backed, min/default 20 GB, size per request, mounted at /cache/bkcache (Linux ext4; macOS sparse bundle). One cache volume per step; plus container-cache (Linux) and Git-mirror volumes. Best-effort attach, not durable. No extra charge (Pro/Enterprise).

volume_shared.quote: Each job gets its own private copy of the volume, as it existed at the time of the last committed volume version.
volume_shared.note: Volumes are shared across steps/branches of one pipeline only as copy-on-write forks (last successful writer wins), never mounted live by several jobs; "volumes cannot be shared across multiple pipelines".
